verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents an official hosted MCP server that supports OAuth browser-based connection. Once connected, an agent gains project management, error investigation, BadgerQL Insights queries and dashboard CRUD, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Our hosted MCP server supports OAuth, so you can connect an agent by approving access in your browser instead of copying and pasting a credential into a config file.
Once connected, your AI assistant gains the following capabilities: Project management... Error investigation... Insights: Run BadgerQL queries against your event data.
Dashboards: List, create, update, and delete Insights dashboards.
